answer.policy_title: CMM-606: Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy, Laminectomy, or Hemilaminectomy)
criteria_quotes: The publicly posted document identifies the service category as “Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy, Laminectomy, or Hemilaminectomy).”

The public Cigna/EviCore materials state that “the terms of an individual's particular coverage plan document ... may differ significantly from the standard coverage plans upon which these guidelines are based.”

The same materials state that coverage determinations require consideration of “the terms of the applicable coverage plan document in effect on the date of service,” “any applicable laws or regulations,” “any relevant collateral source materials including clinical guidelines,” and “the specific facts of the particular situation.”
answer.appeal_deadline: 2027-01-27. The notice states that the appeal must be received within 180 days of 2026-07-31.
answer.submission_route: Call Cigna Customer Service at the telephone number on the member ID card and request an internal medical-necessity appeal. Cigna's member guidance says to begin within 180 calendar days of the denial notice. Submit the written appeal, the appeal form if applicable, and supporting clinical records using the appeal address specified on the member ID card or in the appeal instructions supplied by Cigna. Cigna also provides the public form “Customer Appeal Request”: https://www.cigna.com/static/www-cigna-com/docs/medical-appeal-request.pdf
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: The CMM-606 guideline is publicly available at the policy URL above. However, the retrieved copy could not be text-extracted by the available document reader, so I cannot responsibly quote the operative medical-necessity criteria from it. Ask Cigna, in writing, for the exact CMM-606 version and all clinical-review criteria used for reference number POC-F7C299C469-49918, including any plan-specific criteria, reviewer rationale, and missing documentation identified in the denial. Ask the provider to request the same information through Cigna's utilization-management channel or EviCore, if EviCore performed the review.
answer.confidence: High that CMM-606 is the relevant publicly posted guideline for CPT 63030; low regarding the exact operative criteria because the PDF's criteria pages could not be extracted and should not be reconstructed from secondary sources.
answer.notes: Cigna's public EviCore page lists CMM-606 under “Cigna Commercial Spine Surgery” and describes it as lumbar microdiscectomy. The policy file identifies an effective date of 2026-02-25. The denial letter itself does not state whether the review used Cigna directly or EviCore, nor does it provide a mailing address. Therefore, do not rely on a generic address; use the address on the member ID card or the address Cigna supplies when the appeal is initiated. Cigna's public member guidance also states that a physician is involved in medical-necessity appeals and that pre-service medical-necessity appeals generally receive a decision within 30 calendar days, subject to the plan and applicable state requirements.
